title: zkLLM on AMD Strix Halo — one attention block across three engines

host.cpu_model: AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ PRO 395 w/ Radeon 8060S

path_f_full_forward.gates: solo=true and matching loadavg on both rows of each pair

stage1_forward.verdict: iGPU forward is dispatch-bound for a SINGLE attention head: at the proven seq=8 scale the CPU wins (sub-0.1 ms vs the ~0.13 ms iGPU kernel-launch floor); the iGPU only reaches parity/slight win (best 1.23x at batch=1·seq=512) once batch×seq grows. Forward acceleration is real but SIZE-GATED — the clean 1.9-10.6x iGPU win is the FULL MiniLM (Path F), not one sub-block.

stage2_prove.engine: Zen5 CPU (16c/32t) + 94 GB unified memory — EZKL Halo2 (KZG/BN254)
stage2_prove.verdict: EZKL Halo2 proving is CPU-only on AMD. The iGPU/NPU never touch the proof; the Strix Halo win is 32 threads + 94 GB unified memory holding the CPU-side prover working set at scale.

stage3_msm_frontier.curve: BN254 G1 (the curve EZKL/Halo2 KZG proves over)
stage3_msm_frontier.primitive: MSM (multi-scalar multiplication — dominates Halo2 KZG proving)
stage3_msm_frontier.verdict: The KZG-commitment MSM that dominates Halo2 proving CAN run on this iGPU via OpenCL (Path E), but that is a capability, NOT a speedup at these sizes: the clean-solo BN254 G1 MSM reads 0.654/0.814/0.845x at 2^16/2^18/2^20 and 1.091x at 2^22 over the 32-thread CPU — below parity until ~2^22 (the old 1.1-1.35x small-size win was contention-inflated and is retired). And EZKL upstream wires GPU acceleration only through CUDA (icicle) / Apple Metal — there is no OpenCL/ROCm/Vulkan device path in EZKL's prover. So this is a DOCUMENTED FRONTIER, not a claim of GPU-accelerated proving (see ezkl-gpu.md).

parity.unit: head — proven attention.onnx (seq=8, d_model=384, d_head=32, softmax inside)
parity.statement: The iGPU/CPU forward output and the EZKL Halo2 public output agree within the circuit's fixed-point quantisation tolerance (output scale 2^11, step 4.883e-04); the proof therefore attests the SAME attn_out the engines computed from the committed weights. Exact equality is impossible — the proof is fixed-point, the forward is fp32 — so parity is asserted within tolerance, the strongest claim a quantised SNARK supports.

honesty: iGPU accelerates the model FORWARD only (size-gated; a single attention sub-block at seq=8 is dispatch-bound so the CPU wins). EZKL Halo2 proving is CPU-only on AMD (win = 32 threads + 94 GB unified memory). The KZG MSM could run on the iGPU, but not faster at these sizes (Path E BN254 G1 MSM clean-solo 0.654-1.091x, below parity until ~2^22; the old 1.1-1.35x was contention-inflated and is retired), and EZKL wires only CUDA/Metal -> documented frontier, NOT a GPU-proving claim. Weights are seeded; swapping trained HF tensors is a one-liner that does not change the circuit.
